item.title: From Projectionist to Analyst
item.description: I worked as a projectionist at Celebration Cinema South for nearly four years before I attended the Information Security and Intelligence program at Ferris State University. Since I’ve been on a roll with reflecting on my prior experiences lately, I thought now would be a good opportunity to write about being a projectionist. What was it like? What did I learn? Most importantly, how did my experience prepare me to be a cybersecurity analyst?
